title: Labour Ministry sets Rs 18,000/month wage ceiling for 'supervisory capacity' classification
summary: The Ministry of Labour and Employment notified a revised monthly wage threshold used to decide who counts as a supervisory employee under labour law, relevant for classifying staff correctly under wage and industrial relations rules.

title: Status check: four Labour Codes in force since Nov 2025, full rollout still pending
summary: As of January 2026 the four consolidated labour codes are legally in force, but full operational rules from both central and state governments were still being finalised, meaning several older laws continued to apply in parallel during the transition.

title: Gujarat raises Shops & Establishments applicability threshold from 10 to 20 employees
summary: Gujarat's amendment to its Shops and Establishments Act raises the employee-count threshold that triggers full compliance obligations, and also revises permitted working hours, rest intervals and overtime limits for commercial establishments.

title: Union Budget 2026-27 allocates Rs 32,666 crore to the Labour Ministry
summary: The Union Budget presented on 1 February 2026 set aside roughly Rs 32,666 crore for labour programmes, alongside a 62% jump in skilling spend and over Rs 20,000 crore for employment generation schemes, though trade unions criticised the allocation as largely unchanged from the prior year.

title: Gujarat gazette notifies Social Security Amendment Rules 2026: gratuity eligibility cut to 1 year for fixed-term staff
summary: Published in the Gujarat Official Gazette, these amendment rules reduce the continuous-service requirement for gratuity from five years to one year for fixed-term employees, and introduce a mandatory Rs 15,000 funeral-expense deposit after a fatal workplace injury.

title: EPFO update lets eligible members calculate pension on higher actual wages
summary: Following earlier court directions, EPFO clarified a pathway for eligible private-sector members who had contributed on higher wages to have their pension calculated on those actual wages rather than the older capped wage ceiling, subject to employer verification.

title: Reports discuss proposal to raise EPS minimum pension to Rs 7,500/month - not yet notified
summary: Media reports described a proposal circulating in policy circles to raise the minimum monthly pension under the Employees' Pension Scheme from Rs 1,000 to Rs 7,500, but as of this report no formal government notification had been issued confirming the change.

title: ESI wage ceiling stays at Rs 21,000/month despite industry push for an increase
summary: The ESI coverage wage ceiling, unchanged since 2017, remained at Rs 21,000 per month in gross wages (Rs 25,000 for employees with disabilities), even as industry bodies continued lobbying for a revision under the Code on Social Security.

title: Gujarat minimum wages revised upward by Rs 12/day for April-September 2026
summary: Gujarat's Labour & Employment Department notified revised minimum wage rates effective 1 April to 30 September 2026, raising pay by about Rs 12 per day (Rs 312 per month) across 46 scheduled employments, split by Zone I and Zone II.

title: Gujarat notifies Rs 60.50/day special allowance; garment-sector compliance lapses flagged
summary: Alongside the base wage revision, Gujarat's Labour Commissioner notified a special daily dearness allowance effective April-June 2026; the update cited a real compliance case where a Surat garment manufacturer was penalised for continuing to apply the previous quarter's rate.

title: Gujarat's Shops & Establishments Amendment Act made retrospective to December 2025
summary: Gujarat formally notified its Shops and Establishments Amendment Act 2026, replacing an earlier ordinance and applying its revised employee-count thresholds and working-hour flexibilities retrospectively from 16 December 2025.

title: Labour Codes tracker: around 30 states have now notified rules for at least one code
summary: An implementation-status review found that while the four labour codes carried legal effect from November 2025, state-level readiness varied widely, with roughly 30 states having issued rules for at least one of the four codes by April 2026.

title: Centre notifies final Central Rules for all four Labour Codes
summary: The Ministry of Labour and Employment notified the final central rules under the Wage Code, Social Security Code, Industrial Relations Code and OSH Code, setting out detailed procedures for wage calculation, safety standards and dispute resolution wherever the central government is the appropriate authority.

title: ESIC clarifies coverage rules when an employee's wages cross the ceiling mid-period
summary: A government notification addressed a common payroll question: an employee remains covered under ESI for the rest of the ongoing contribution period even if a mid-cycle raise takes their gross wages above the Rs 21,000 threshold.

title: Gujarat confirmed among states with rules notified across all four Labour Codes
summary: A compliance guide listed Gujarat, alongside Maharashtra, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh and Delhi, as having notified state rules across all four labour codes by May 2026, though it noted a phased registration window was still being rolled out for employers.

title: ESIC's '50% wage rule' becomes enforceable, closing a salary-structuring loophole
summary: Under the Code on Social Security, basic pay plus dearness allowance must now make up at least 50% of an employee's gross wages, closing off a common practice of structuring salaries with a low basic component specifically to reduce ESI contribution liability.

title: Government notifies EPF Scheme 2026, replacing the 1952 rules; PF interest rate unchanged at 8.25%
summary: The long-standing EPF Scheme of 1952 was formally replaced by the EPF Scheme 2026 under the Code on Social Security, mainly modernising the legal structure and giving formal recognition to EPFO's existing digital services, while leaving the 8.25% annual interest rate and contribution structure unchanged.

title: EPFO opens Enrolment Campaign 2026 amnesty window for employers (1 Jul - 31 Oct)
summary: EPFO launched a special amnesty window running from 1 July to 31 October 2026, letting employers voluntarily declare previously unregistered or left-out employees without the usual penalties, alongside continued 8.25% interest crediting via its new CITES 2.01 system.

title: State tracker (Aug 2026): Gujarat among four states with final notified Labour Code rules
summary: A state-by-state labour code tracker updated through August 2026 listed Gujarat, alongside Arunachal Pradesh, Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, as having final notified rules across the codes, while several other large states remained at the draft-rule stage.
